messages:
owen: hey team, hit a CI-only failure on the rb-sampleapp after bumping Faraday. local mac/linux runs fine but windows gha fails on a native load. anyone have quick tips?
jess: can you paste the failure snippet? sometimes transitive native ext pops in.
owen: here's the failing bit from the GH runner: 
```
LoadError: cannot load such file -- win32/dir_helper
/home/runner/work/redwood/rb-sampleapp/test/test_auth_retry.rb:21
```
this started after `bundle update faraday` (2.8.0 -> 2.9.0).
tai: sounds like multipart-post or another dep compiled a native. quick repro: `bundle lock --add-platform x86_64-mingw32` then `bundle install --local` on mac will fetch mingw versions. also `act` with windows image helps.
maya: short-term we can pin the transitive gem to a pure-ruby version in the gemspec for the samples, or vendor a tiny shim. long-term we should add a windows matrix sanity check locally.
oj: (typo, meant jess) Also, unrelated, noticed the ruby client retry backoff differs from go/java. it defaulted to linear in an earlier PR. we should add an explicit unit test to lock behavior so future bumps don't regress parity.
owen: good point, I'll add a small test asserting backoff timings. can reviewers prefer exponential like other SDKs?
jess: exponential is fine; parity priority order: go -> py -> rb. If we change behavior, mark as semver-minor and note in changelog.
sam: for the PR keep changes minimal: pin the problematic transitive gem in Gemfile.lock or add the `--add-platform` lockfile change and the unit test. include a quick dev note in CONTRIBUTING about reproducing Windows CI.
owen: will do. creating a draft PR in a few mins. plan: 1) update Gemfile.lock with added platform, 2) pin multipart-post to ~>2.1 if that's the culprit, 3) add `test/retry_policy_test.rb` asserting backoff(2) == expected, 4) add a one-line changelog.
maya: if windows runner still flakes, add a skip for that particular test on Windows with a link to an upstream issue and file a follow-up ticket.
tai: small tip: in CI use `bundle config set without 'development'` for the windows job to avoid optional native dev gems. helped us before.
owen: thanks, will include that in the CI job too. draft PR: #2510. linux/mac green, windows queued.
devex-bot: CI troubleshooting doc: https://redwood-internal.devex/ci-windows#native-gems :robot_face: 
owen: updated PR with lockfile + backoff test. pinging reviewers @sam @jess for quick eyes.
sam: taking a look now. quick scan looks fine, small nits inline.
jess: LGTM after nits, thanks for keeping changes minimal. merge once windows passes or skip landed with issue linked.
owen: merging after windows job passes or skip applied. thanks all!
